The 90 year old suffers from macular degeneration, and her garden is a green-free concrete box - with so many levels and trip hazards that it's off limits to the sight-impaired dare-devil fundraiser, so the team sets about transforming it into a safe haven

event.name: Garden Rescue
event.description: Charlie Dimmock and Chris Hull head to Godalming, Surrey, to transform a new plot on a budget of £6,000. Chloe and Peter's garden has a strict tree preservation order on four of the trees. The couple envision a blend of arts and crafts and French formality in their new garden. The two designers set about interpreting these very different, almost conflicting ideas in their pitches before the successful proposal is chosen and acted upon
